bigIdeas.en: Numbers describe quantities that can be represented by equivalent fractions.
bigIdeas.zh: 数描述数量；同一个数量可以用等值分数来表示。

bigIdeas.en: Computational fluency and flexibility with numbers extend to operations with larger (multi-digit) numbers.
bigIdeas.zh: 运算的熟练和灵活，扩展到更大（多位数）的运算。

bigIdeas.en: Identified regularities in number patterns can be expressed in tables.
bigIdeas.zh: 在数的规律中发现的规则，可以用表格表示出来。

bigIdeas.en: Closed shapes have area and perimeter that can be described, measured, and compared.
bigIdeas.zh: 封闭图形有面积和周长，可以描述、测量和比较。

bigIdeas.en: Data represented in graphs can be used to show many-to-one correspondence.
bigIdeas.zh: 用统计图表示的数据，可以呈现多对一的对应关系。

elaborations.en: counting: multiples; flexible counting strategies; whole number benchmarks
elaborations.zh: 数数：按倍数跳着数；灵活的数数策略；整数基准点

elaborations.en: Numbers to 1 000 000 can be arranged and recognized: comparing and ordering numbers; estimating large quantities
elaborations.zh: 1 000 000 以内的数可以排一排、认一认：比较和排序；估计大数量

elaborations.en: place value: 100 000s, 10 000s, 1000s, 100s, 10s, and 1s; understanding the relationship between digit places and their value, to 1 000 000
elaborations.zh: 数位：十万位、万位、千位、百位、十位、个位；理解数位和位值的关系（到 1 000 000）

elaborations.en: First Peoples use unique counting systems (e.g., Tsimshian use of three counting systems, for animals, people and things; Tlingit counting for the naming of numbers e.g., 10 = two hands, 20 = one person)
elaborations.zh: 原住民有独特的计数系统（如 Tsimshian 人对动物、人、物品分别用三套计数；Tlingit 人用身体给数命名：10 = 两只手，20 = 一个人）

items.zh: 整数、分数、小数的基准点比较

elaborations.en: Two equivalent fractions are two ways to represent the same amount (having the same whole).
elaborations.zh: 两个等值分数是同一个数量的两种表示（整体相同）。

elaborations.en: comparing and ordering of fractions and decimals
elaborations.zh: 分数和小数的比较与排序

elaborations.en: addition and subtraction of decimals to thousandths
elaborations.zh: 小数加减法（到千分位）

elaborations.en: estimating decimal sums and differences
elaborations.zh: 估算小数的和与差

elaborations.en: estimating fractions with benchmarks (e.g., zero, half, whole)
elaborations.zh: 用基准点估计分数大小（如 0、一半、1）

elaborations.en: equal partitioning
elaborations.zh: 平均分（等分）

items.en: addition and subtraction of whole numbers to 1 000 000

elaborations.en: using flexible computation strategies involving taking apart (e.g., decomposing using friendly numbers and compensating) and combining numbers in a variety of ways, regrouping
elaborations.zh: 用灵活的计算策略：拆数（比如凑成好算的数再补偿）、多种方式组合数、进位退位

elaborations.en: estimating sums and differences to 10 000
elaborations.zh: 估算和与差（到 10 000）

elaborations.en: using addition and subtraction in real-life contexts and problem-based situations
elaborations.zh: 在生活情境和实际问题中用加减法

elaborations.en: whole-class number talks
elaborations.zh: 全班数学漫谈（number talk）

items.en: multiplication and division to three digits, including division with remainders
items.zh: 乘除法到三位数（含有余数的除法）

elaborations.en: understanding the relationships between multiplication and division, multiplication and addition, and division and subtraction
elaborations.zh: 理解乘法和除法、乘法和加法、除法和减法之间的关系

elaborations.en: using flexible computation strategies (e.g., decomposing, distributive principle, commutative principle, repeated addition, repeated subtraction)
elaborations.zh: 用灵活的计算策略（如拆数、分配律、交换律、连加、连减）

elaborations.en: using multiplication and division in real-life contexts and problem-based situations
elaborations.zh: 在生活情境和实际问题中用乘除法

elaborations.en: whole-class number talks
elaborations.zh: 全班数学漫谈（number talk）

items.en: addition and subtraction of decimals to thousandths

elaborations.en: estimating decimal sums and differences
elaborations.zh: 估算小数的和与差

elaborations.en: using visual models such as base 10 blocks, place-value mats, grid paper, and number lines
elaborations.zh: 借助图形模型：十进制积木、数位表、方格纸、数轴

elaborations.en: using addition and subtraction in real-life contexts and problem-based situations
elaborations.zh: 在生活情境和实际问题中用小数加减法

elaborations.en: whole-class number talks
elaborations.zh: 全班数学漫谈（number talk）

items.en: addition and subtraction facts to 20 (extending computational fluency)
items.zh: 20 以内加减法口算（拓展熟练）

elaborations.en: Provide opportunities for authentic practice, building on previous grade-level addition and subtraction facts.
elaborations.zh: 在真实情境里多练习，巩固之前年级学过的加减法口算。

elaborations.en: applying strategies and knowledge of addition and subtraction facts in real-life contexts and problem-based situations, as well as when making math-to-math connections (e.g., for 800 + 700, you can annex the zeros and use the knowledge of 8 + 7 to find the total)
elaborations.zh: 在生活情境、实际问题和数学联结中运用加减口算（如算 800 + 700，可以先去掉零，用 8 + 7 推出 1500）

items.en: multiplication and division facts to 100 (emerging computational fluency)
items.zh: 100 以内乘除法口算（初步熟练）

elaborations.en: Provide opportunities for concrete and pictorial representations of multiplication.
elaborations.zh: 多用实物和画图来表示乘法。

elaborations.en: Use games to provide opportunities for authentic practice of multiplication computations.
elaborations.zh: 用游戏来真实地练乘法。

elaborations.en: looking for patterns in numbers, such as in a hundred chart, to further develop understanding of multiplication computation
elaborations.zh: 在百数表等地方找数的规律，加深对乘法的理解

elaborations.en: Connect multiplication to skip-counting.
elaborations.zh: 把乘法和跳着数联系起来。

elaborations.en: Connect multiplication to division and repeated addition.
elaborations.zh: 把乘法和除法、连加联系起来。

elaborations.en: Memorization of facts is not intended this level.
elaborations.zh: 这个阶段不要求死记硬背。

elaborations.en: Students will become more fluent with these facts.
elaborations.zh: 孩子会在练习中越来越熟。

elaborations.en: using mental math strategies such as doubling and halving, annexing, and distributive property
elaborations.zh: 用翻倍减半、去零补零、分配律等心算策略

elaborations.en: Students should be able to recall many multiplication facts by the end of Grade 5 (e.g., 2s, 3s, 4s, 5s, 10s).
elaborations.zh: 五年级结束时应能脱口而出许多乘法口算（如 2、3、4、5、10 的）。

elaborations.en: developing computational fluency with facts to 100
elaborations.zh: 逐步练熟 100 以内的口算

items.en: rules for increasing and decreasing patterns with words, numbers, symbols, and variables
items.zh: 递增递减规律的法则（用语言、数字、符号和变量）

elaborations.en: solving one-step equations with a variable
elaborations.zh: 解含一个变量的一步方程

elaborations.en: expressing a given problem as an equation, using symbols (e.g., 4 + X = 15)
elaborations.zh: 把问题写成含符号的方程（如 4 + X = 15）

items.en: area measurement of squares and rectangles
items.zh: 正方形和长方形的面积

elaborations.en: measuring area of squares and rectangles, using tiles, geoboards, grid paper
elaborations.zh: 用瓷砖片、钉板、方格纸测量正方形和长方形的面积

elaborations.en: investigating perimeter and area and how they are related to but not dependent on each other
elaborations.zh: 探究周长和面积：它们有关联，但谁也不决定谁

elaborations.en: use traditional dwellings
elaborations.zh: 以原住民传统民居为素材

elaborations.en: Invite a local Elder or knowledge keeper to talk about traditional measuring and estimating techniques for hunting, fishing, and building.
elaborations.zh: 请本地原住民长者或文化传承人讲讲打猎、捕鱼、建造中的传统测量和估算方法。

elaborations.en: understanding elapsed time and duration
elaborations.zh: 理解经过时间和时长

elaborations.en: applying concepts of time in real-life contexts and problem-based situations
elaborations.zh: 在生活情境和实际问题中运用时间概念

elaborations.en: daily and seasonal cycles, moon cycles, tides, journeys, events
elaborations.zh: 昼夜与季节循环、月相、潮汐、旅程、活动安排

elaborations.en: investigating 3D objects and 2D shapes, based on multiple attributes
elaborations.zh: 按多种特征研究立体图形和平面图形

elaborations.en: describing and sorting quadrilaterals
elaborations.zh: 描述和分类四边形

elaborations.en: describing and constructing rectangular and triangular prisms
elaborations.zh: 描述并搭建长方体和三棱柱

elaborations.en: identifying prisms in the environment
elaborations.zh: 在身边环境中找棱柱

items.zh: 单一变换（平移、翻折、旋转）

elaborations.en: single transformations (slide/translation, flip/reflection, turn/rotation)
elaborations.zh: 单一变换：平移（slide/translation）、翻折（flip/reflection）、旋转（turn/rotation）

elaborations.en: using concrete materials with a focus on the motion of transformations
elaborations.zh: 用实物操作，重点感受变换的运动过程

elaborations.en: weaving, cedar baskets, designs
elaborations.zh: 编织、雪松篮、图案设计中的变换

items.en: one-to-one correspondence and many-to-one correspondence, using double bar graphs
items.zh: 复式条形统计图（一对一与多对一）

elaborations.en: many-to-one correspondence: one symbol represents a group or value (e.g., on a bar graph, one square may represent five cookies)
elaborations.zh: 多对一：一个符号代表一组数量（如条形图上一格代表 5 块饼干）

items.en: probability experiments, single events or outcomes

elaborations.en: predicting outcomes of independent events (e.g., when you spin using a spinner and it lands on a single colour)
elaborations.zh: 预测独立事件的结果（如转一次转盘，指针停在某种颜色）

elaborations.en: predicting single outcomes (e.g., when you spin using a spinner and it lands on a single colour)
elaborations.zh: 预测单次结果（如转一次转盘，指针停在某种颜色）

elaborations.en: using spinners, rolling dice, pulling objects out of a bag
elaborations.zh: 转转盘、掷骰子、从袋子里摸东西

elaborations.en: representing single outcome probabilities using fractions
elaborations.zh: 用分数表示单一结果的可能性

items.en: financial literacy — monetary calculations, including making change with amounts to 1000 dollars and developing simple financial plans
items.zh: 钱的计算与简单理财计划（1000 元以内找零）

elaborations.en: making monetary calculations, including making change and decimal notation to $1000 in real-life contexts and problem-based situations
elaborations.zh: 在生活情境和实际问题中算钱、找零，会用小数记法（到 $1000）

elaborations.en: applying a variety of strategies, such as counting up, counting back, and decomposing, to calculate totals and make change
elaborations.zh: 用往上数、往回数、拆数等多种策略算总价和找零

elaborations.en: making simple financial plans to meet a financial goal
elaborations.zh: 制定简单的理财计划，达成一个存钱目标

elaborations.en: developing a budget that takes into account income and expenses
elaborations.zh: 编一份考虑收入和支出的预算
